samples.evidence: Thirty-four adolescents (mean age 15.2 years, SD = 1.5) referred by school counsellors were randomly assigned to either cCBT or a computer-administered attention placebo program with psychoeducational content (CPE). 34 were randomized; 17 participants were assigned to each group. The mean age of participants was 15.2 years of age (SD = 1.5); 41% of respondents were female.
